W19-2 connectors-oauth-return-live-refresh (opus) — branch loop-epic/oauth-return-poll-refresh-slack-token-re-1, reviewer branch …-1-r. The D179 fold landed clean. Drift is a loud stderr warning by default, a hard fail under CLOUD_SANDBOX_CLAUDE_VERSION_STRICT=1 (version is observed-not-contractual per cloud_policy.ex:57, so a patch bump must not abort live turns). Gate re-run: node --check clean + all 5 proof legs green (fallback+pinned GREEN with pinned install argv, fallback+wrong RED, snapshot+pinned GREEN with no npm exec, snapshot+wrong RED, strict+wrong HARD FAIL with zero turn execs); w12 + w14 regression proofs both still exit 0. What shipped is correct, well-documented, and red-first protective-test-proven; the deliberate load_installs deviation is a genuine correctness improvement over the literal brief. What drags the grade below A-: the wave lost a full third of its planned scope to a silent Fable no-show, and the slice that didn't land — the WhatsApp restart-survival wiring — was the wave's most substantive intended defect-closure (the other two are a UX-refresh poll and a version-drift guard). A wave that ships 2/3 where the missing 1 is the meatiest earns B+, not A-.
